Assessment Objective: Verify that information security policies are approved and reviewed

Assessment Objective: Determine whether relevant cybersecurity threat intelligence is collected and analyzed

Recommendation: Establish a threat intelligence review process and retain records

Recommendation: Create and maintain a complete inventory of information and associated assets

Gap Identified: Access control requirements are not consistently applied across applications
Recommendation: Standardize access control requirements and monitor implementation

Assessment Objective: Verify that access rights are reviewed and adjusted
Gap Identified: Review records do not cover all critical applications
Recommendation: Implement periodic access reviews for all critical applications

Assessment Objective: Determine whether supplier security risks are managed

Recommendation: Establish a risk-based supplier security assessment process

Control Name: Addressing information security within supplier agreements

Gap Identified: Security requirements are not consistently documented in supplier agreements
Recommendation: Review supplier agreements and define appropriate security clauses

Control Name: Information security for use of cloud services
